query: Memory-Augmented LLM Agents: Mechanisms, Evaluation, and Reliability in Multi-Agent Systems
inclusion_criteria: Directly addresses LLM agent memory mechanisms, management, or evaluation.
Provides a reusable design pattern, benchmark, or empirical finding.
Has a stable arXiv or publisher URL for reference verification.

memory mechanism.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
memory mechanism.contribution: Introduces virtual context management with memory tiers inspired by operating systems.

memory mechanism.title: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
memory mechanism.contribution: Implements long-term user memory with updating and forgetting mechanisms for sustained interaction.

memory mechanism.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
memory mechanism.contribution: Uses verbal reflections stored in episodic memory to improve later agent trials without weight updates.

memory mechanism.title: A Survey on the Memory Mechanism of Large Language Model based Agents
memory mechanism.contribution: Provides an early systematic review of memory design, evaluation, applications, and limitations in LLM agents.

memory mechanism.title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
memory mechanism.contribution: Proposes an agentic memory system that dynamically organizes memories using Zettelkasten-style indexing, linking, and memory evolution.
memory mechanism.evidence: verified via arXiv page; accepted at NeurIPS 2025

memory mechanism.title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
memory mechanism.contribution: Presents a scalable memory-centric architecture that extracts, consolidates, and retrieves salient conversational information, including a graph-memory variant.

memory mechanism.title: Memory for Autonomous LLM Agents: Mechanisms, Evaluation, and Emerging Frontiers
memory mechanism.contribution: Frames agent memory as a write-manage-read loop and surveys mechanism families through early 2026.

memory reliability.title: How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
memory reliability.contribution: Shows how addition and deletion policies affect long-term behavior, error propagation, and stale replay.

memory reliability.title: MemOS: An Operating System for Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) in Large Language Models
memory reliability.contribution: Frames memory as a first-class operational resource with lifecycle governance across parametric, activation, and plaintext memory.

multi-agent and embodied memory.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
multi-agent and embodied memory.contribution: Combines observation, memory retrieval, reflection, and planning for believable multi-agent social behavior.

multi-agent and embodied memory.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
multi-agent and embodied memory.contribution: Demonstrates procedural skill memory through an expanding library of executable behaviors.

memory evaluation.title: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents
memory evaluation.contribution: Introduces LoCoMo, a benchmark for very long-term dialogue memory across many sessions.

memory evaluation.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
memory evaluation.contribution: Evaluates extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and abstention.

memory evaluation.title: Evaluating Memory in LLM Agents via Incremental Multi-Turn Interactions
memory evaluation.contribution: Introduces MemoryAgentBench to evaluate accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting in incremental multi-turn interactions.

memory evaluation.title: Evaluating Memory Structure in LLM Agents
memory evaluation.contribution: Proposes StructMemEval to test whether agents organize memory into task-appropriate structures.

memory evaluation.title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
memory evaluation.contribution: Evaluates whether agents acquire environment-specific experience from long web-agent trajectories.

multi-agent orchestration.title: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework
multi-agent orchestration.contribution: Shows how SOP-style workflows and role specialization can reduce cascading hallucinations in LLM-based multi-agent collaboration.
